verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own docs say Auto Drafts and Email Assistant write a draft for every message that needs a reply, matched to the voice and tone of the user's sent emails and styled per recipient. Drafts are framed as ready to edit and send, and plain-language instructions can personalize the writing further. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that drafts actually sound like the user rather than generic boilerplate.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate

citations.quote: Superhuman AI matches the voice and tone in the emails you've already sent
Every message that needs a reply comes with a draft written in your voice.
Every draft matches your voice and tone, using your unique style for each person. You can review the drafts in Superhuman Mail
with Auto Drafts 2.0, every message that needs a reply comes with a draft. You can just edit and send.
Add plain-language instructions like "write in lowercase" or "use this booking link" to personalize your writing and scheduling features.
